messages.subject: error in BAYAREA+J  - check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
parts:
Hello

I'm getting this error from running BAYAREAJ:

Error in check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object) : 
  check_BioGeoBEARS_run() says: STOP ERROR: 1 row(s) of the BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table are set to be 'free', but they have starting values ('init') outside of the specified min/max.

Fix manually, or run fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax(). Printing these rows to screen....

I attempted inserting fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax() into the script and fiddling with some of the parameters to no avail.

Happening on both on Linux HPC & Windows10

Many thanks

Clive

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] error in BAYAREA+J - check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
parts:
Hi -- the error message explains it -- change your initial value to be inside the min/max limits.  Sometimes the ML parameters from BAYAREALIKE might be starting values outside the limits set for BAYAREALIKE+J.

Look at, and edit, this model table...as is done in the example script several times:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object$BioGeoBEARS_model_object@params_table

Cheers,
Nick
